Never resolve an entire file with ours/theirs without evidence. Keep the two-parent merge pending for the later commit step.

The Codex sandbox can edit the worktree but may not write the Git index. Leave resolved files in the worktree; the following trusted commit step stages them and checks for conflict markers before running the full test suite. Do not call an unstaged index a release blocker. Record any tests you could not run here as pending the commit step, not as passed. Preserve HCAI home, plugin settings persistence, model plaza display pricing versus actual billing, menus and credential isolation, payment/referrals, images/MinIO, multi-node coordination and cache invalidation, translations, CI and release behavior. Run relevant focused tests and fix problems in this checkout. Do not access production, make paid upstream calls, push, merge a PR, create a Release, or deploy. If a decision cannot be supported by evidence, leave a clearly marked blocker in the review and explain it in the final message.
